scientific_question: Does task-protected basis selection reduce task-relevant leakage relative to acquisition-only suppression while retaining non-trivial acquisition capture?
design_role: Prospective novelty-dissection pilot. This is a new experiment and is not an attempt to reproduce or replace historical Stage6R/Stage7R numerical results.

recovery_limitation.reason: The original Stage6R-A identity-repair artifact / exact historical row-order was not recovered. Data identity, preprocessing, source counts, and split assignments were independently reconstructed and audited. Stage9A therefore uses a new row-order-invariant, prospectively locked basis-sample rule.
recovery_limitation.historical_results_policy: Historical Stage6R/Stage7R results remain reported from their preserved archives and are not overwritten by Stage9A.

basis_estimation_lock.selection_rule: For each source fold, sort source-train rows by SHA256('MedAIN_STAGE9A_V1|<target_domain>|<sample_uid>') and select the first 24. The rule is independent of CSV row order and model seed.

TP.label: Task-protected
TP.basis: top-r generalized eigenvectors of A u = lambda (T + beta I) u, thin QR

AO.label: Acquisition-only
AO.basis: top-r eigenvectors of normalized A, thin QR

RAND.label: Matched-rank random projection
RAND.basis: deterministic Gaussian basis followed by thin QR; fold/stage-specific locked seed

primary_mechanistic_endpoints: task_leakage_ratio for TP, AO, RAND at stage1 and stage2
acquisition_capture_ratio for TP, AO, RAND at stage1 and stage2
secondary_endpoints: source-validation mean foreground Dice for OFF, TP, AO, RAND
source-validation loss for OFF, TP, AO, RAND
principal angles between TP and AO subspaces
all CA/CT matrices and TP/AO/RAND bases saved as NPZ

pilot_go_rule.purpose: Decide whether a full confirmatory Stage9 expansion is scientifically justified; pilot is not final inferential evidence.
requirements: TP task leakage < AO in at least 4/5 folds at stage1 AND at least 4/5 folds at stage2.
TP protection efficiency > AO in at least 4/5 folds at stage1 AND at least 4/5 folds at stage2.
TP acquisition capture > RAND in at least 4/5 folds at stage1 AND at least 4/5 folds at stage2.
Source-validation task preservation must not show a systematic contrary pattern: TP validation Dice >= AO in at least 3/5 folds OR the mean TP-AO Dice difference must be non-negative.
pilot_go_rule.if_go: Expand to seeds 2207 and 3301 under the same locked protocol, then perform the confirmatory 15-pair analysis; only after confirmatory support consider end-to-end TP vs AO training.
pilot_go_rule.if_no_go: Freeze MedAIN algorithmic novelty development; do not add larger benchmark or additional tuning.

claim_boundary: Stage9A pilot can support or refute the necessity of task-protected basis selection within this retinal segmentation setting. It cannot establish universal superiority, cross-modality generality, or external predictive superiority.
